highlights.title: Refunds lower your spending
highlights.detail: Money back, such as a return or a flatmate's share of the rent, now lowers spending in its own category. Spent shows the amount after refunds.

highlights.title: Income is only income
highlights.detail: Income now counts only salary, money from family, student loans and interest.

highlights.title: Refunds by merchant
highlights.detail: A new panel on Overview shows who paid money back.
